name: Aimflex Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未发布涉及业务扩张、新业务、缩减或出售的公告，所获公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及公司秘书变更等常规事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长29.2%，净利润同比增长88.0%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any business expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment; announcements were mainly routine matters such as quarterly results, general meetings, and change of company secretary. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 29.2% year-on-year and net profit grew 88.0% year-on-year.
